exposure: preoperative administration of gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonist (GnRHa)
cohort: 160 patients who underwent either laparoscopic or minilaparotomic myomectomy for uterine leiomyomas between 2007 and 2013, with a minimum 2-year follow-up for recurrence.
finding: Laparoscopic myomectomy (LM) and minilaparotomic myomectomy (MM) showed similar recurrence rates and reproductive outcomes, with preoperative administration of GnRHa identified as the only significant recurrence factor.
mod_finding: Delivery methods were not significantly different between the LM and MM groups.
